root_cause.text: The vulnerability arises because the BPF verifier function `map_kptr_match_type` accesses the `reg->btf` pointer via `btf_is_kernel()` without first ensuring the register type is `PTR_TO_BTF_ID`, causing a NULL dereference when processing scalar registers that lack a BTF type.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly identifies that "A scalar register stored into a kptr slot has no btf, so the btf_is_kernel(reg->btf) call dereferences NULL," and the patch resolves this by inserting a `base_type(reg->type) != PTR_TO_BTF_ID` guard before any `reg->btf` access.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement accesses reg->btf via btf_is_kernel() without first ensuring the register type is PTR_TO_BTF_ID. When processing scalar registers that lack a BTF type, reg->btf will be NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability. The fix requires adding a type check (base_type(reg->type) != PTR_TO_BTF_ID) before this access.
